name: seo_geo_marketing_ai_skills
description: An open-source collection of SEO, geolocation, and marketing capabilities designed for AI agents to enhance online presence and targeted marketing strategies.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: SEO or marketing-related query or command to be processed by the AI skill.

inputs.name: location_data
inputs.description: Geographical information input used to tailor SEO or marketing strategies based on location.

inputs.name: content_data
inputs.description: Text content or URL input to analyze or optimize for SEO purposes.

inputs.name: marketing_parameters
inputs.description: Marketing campaign details and parameters to generate strategy suggestions.

outputs.name: seo_strategy
outputs.description: Recommendations and actionable SEO strategies derived from inputs.

outputs.name: geo_targeting_info
outputs.description: Location-based marketing insights and targeting information generated.

outputs.name: marketing_plan
outputs.description: Comprehensive marketing skill outputs including campaign suggestions and optimizations.

outputs.name: response_text
outputs.description: Textual output summarizing findings or advice delivered by the AI agent.

patterns: Natural language processing for marketing queries
Adaptive marketing skill integration for autonomous agents
steps: Receive and parse input parameters including SEO content, location data, and marketing constraints.
Analyze content and keywords for SEO improvements using AI techniques.
Incorporate geographical data to tailor marketing and SEO recommendations.
Generate targeted marketing strategies based on AI analysis of inputs.
Output structured recommendations and textual advice usable by AI agents.
use_cases: Enhancing website SEO performance with AI-generated strategies.
Creating geo-targeted marketing campaigns for localized audience reach.
Automating SEO and marketing advice for chatbots or AI assistants.
Integrating SEO and marketing skills into AI agent workflows for digital marketing tasks.

prompt_templates.name: seo_analysis_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Analyze the following content for SEO improvements: {content_data}

prompt_templates.name: geo_targeting_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Provide geo-targeted marketing strategies based on this location: {location_data}

prompt_templates.name: marketing_strategy_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a marketing plan with these parameters: {marketing_parameters}

prompt_templates.name: agent_query_prompt
prompt_templates.template: As an AI agent, provide SEO, GEO, and marketing skills response to: {query}
